title: Preposition + which / whom · 要点精讲
summary: Preposition + which/whom structure in formal written style; the preposition comes from the collocation with the verb.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。

title: whose relative clauses · 要点精讲
summary: whose introduces a relative clause expressing belonging to the antecedent, followed by a noun.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。

title: Noun clauses with what · 要点精讲
summary: What guides a noun clause and itself serves as a subject or object inside the clause, meaning 'what/who'.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。

title: Subject clauses with whether · 要点精讲
summary: Whether guides a subject clause at the start of a sentence; if is not used; the clause uses statement word order.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。

title: Subject clauses with that · 要点精讲
summary: A that-clause as subject is usually replaced by the formal subject it: It is clear that...本课为要点精讲练习,核心:That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。

title: Present participles as adverbials · 要点精讲
summary: A present participle phrase as adverbial; its logical subject must agree with the sentence's subject.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。

title: Past participles as adverbials · 要点精讲
summary: A past participle phrase as adverbial, the logical subject passively receives the action.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。

title: Perfect infinitives · 要点精讲
summary: The perfect infinitive expresses an action that happened before the predicate verb.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。

title: as concession inversion · 要点精讲
summary: The as-concession inversion: Young as he is, he knows a lot.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。

title: while / whereas contrast · 要点精讲
summary: while used at the start of a sentence means 'whereas', connecting two contrasting clauses.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。

title: Compound sentences and semicolons · 要点精讲
summary: Semicolons join parallel clauses; the linking adverbs however/therefore need a semicolon before them.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。

title: Appositives · 要点精讲
summary: An appositive further explains the preceding noun and can be a word, phrase or clause.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。

title: Parentheticals · 要点精讲
summary: A parenthetical is inserted in the middle of a sentence such as I think / to be frank / believe it or not; the word order stays unchanged.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。

title: Ellipsis in adverbial clauses · 要点精讲
summary: Ellipsis in adverbial clauses: when the subject is the same and be is present, omit 'subject + be', keeping only the conjunction + complement.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。

title: Subjunctive mood after wish · 情景运用
summary: The object clause after wish uses the subjunctive mood: past expresses a present wish, past perfect expresses past regret.本课为情景运用练习,核心:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。

title: Subjunctive mood after suggest / insist · 情景运用
summary: After suggest, insist, demand, order, the object clause uses (should) + base verb.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。

title: Mixed subjunctive moods · 情景运用
summary: Mixed subjunctive moods: the time referenced by the if clause differs from the main clause; choose the tense separately.本课为情景运用练习,核心:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。

title: Inversion with fronted negative words · 情景运用
summary: Negative or semi-negative adverbs at the start of a sentence require partial inversion.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。

title: only + adverbial inversion · 情景运用
summary: When only + adverbial (time/condition) is fronted, partial inversion is used; only modifying the subject does not invert.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。

title: so / neither partial inversion · 情景运用
summary: so/neither indicates 'the same is true (not)' and takes partial inversion, avoiding repetition.本课为情景运用练习,核心:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。

title: Cleft sentences It is...that · 情景运用
summary: Cleft sentences emphasize the subject, object or adverbial: It is...that/who..., the tense stays unchanged.本课为情景运用练习,核心:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。

title: Formal subject it · 情景运用
summary: it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为情景运用练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。

title: Formal object it · 情景运用
summary: it acts as formal object, replacing the infinitive or clause object placed after the complement.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。

title: with compound structures · 情景运用
summary: The with compound structure expresses accompanying state; the complement is determined by the relation to the noun.本课为情景运用练习,核心:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。

title: Absolute constructions · 情景运用
summary: The absolute construction = noun + adjective/adverb/past participle/infinitive, as an adverbial expressing time, reason or accompanying state.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。

title: Non-restrictive relative clauses · 情景运用
summary: Non-restrictive relative clauses add supplementary explanation; a comma is essential, that is forbidden.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。

title: Preposition + which / whom · 情景运用
summary: Preposition + which/whom structure in formal written style; the preposition comes from the collocation with the verb.本课为情景运用练习,核心:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。

title: whose relative clauses · 情景运用
summary: whose introduces a relative clause expressing belonging to the antecedent, followed by a noun.本课为情景运用练习,核心:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。

title: Noun clauses with what · 情景运用
summary: What guides a noun clause and itself serves as a subject or object inside the clause, meaning 'what/who'.本课为情景运用练习,核心:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。

title: Subject clauses with whether · 情景运用
summary: Whether guides a subject clause at the start of a sentence; if is not used; the clause uses statement word order.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。

title: Subject clauses with that · 情景运用
summary: A that-clause as subject is usually replaced by the formal subject it: It is clear that...本课为情景运用练习,核心:That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。

title: Present participles as adverbials · 情景运用
summary: A present participle phrase as adverbial; its logical subject must agree with the sentence's subject.本课为情景运用练习,核心:V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。

title: Past participles as adverbials · 情景运用
summary: A past participle phrase as adverbial, the logical subject passively receives the action.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。

title: Perfect infinitives · 情景运用
summary: The perfect infinitive expresses an action that happened before the predicate verb.本课为情景运用练习,核心:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。

title: as concession inversion · 情景运用
summary: The as-concession inversion: Young as he is, he knows a lot.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。

title: while / whereas contrast · 情景运用
summary: while used at the start of a sentence means 'whereas', connecting two contrasting clauses.本课为情景运用练习,核心:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。

title: Compound sentences and semicolons · 情景运用
summary: Semicolons join parallel clauses; the linking adverbs however/therefore need a semicolon before them.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。

title: Appositives · 情景运用
summary: An appositive further explains the preceding noun and can be a word, phrase or clause.本课为情景运用练习,核心:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。

title: Parentheticals · 情景运用
summary: A parenthetical is inserted in the middle of a sentence such as I think / to be frank / believe it or not; the word order stays unchanged.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。
